connector.name: Newsmind
connector.registryDescription: RSS feeds for ChatGPT & Claude: semantic search, story clustering, keyword watches, OPML import.
connector.summary: Hosted at newsmind.app over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.newsmind, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Claude.ai and ChatGPT handle OAuth automatically. For other clients, generate a PAT (nm_pat_…) at https://newsmind.app/auth/tokens?utm_source=mcp-registry
